question:
This is my dbt config

{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='append',
    pre_hook='DELETE FROM {{ this }} WHERE r_date <> CURRENT_DATE
  )
}}

This model is to be run on DBT.

I received an error upon dbt run command, and it was from pre_hook, as a standard SQL error, suggesting my prehook couldn't find {{ this }} model to delete data from.

Does a one time DDL is needed to create the skeleton of this model before this one can be run by dbt?
title: dbt pre hook deleting a table that was not built yet
answer:
You can have the pre-hook optionally run depending on if you're doing a full refresh vs incremental job run.

{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='append',
    pre_hook='{% if is_incremental() %} DELETE FROM {{ this }} WHERE r_date <> CURRENT_DATE {% endif %}'
  )
}}
